name: video
description: Motion graphics video built with Remotion

scripts.music: node scripts/generate-music.mjs && ffmpeg -v error -y -i public/audio/music.wav -b:a 192k public/audio/music.mp3 && rm public/audio/music.wav
scripts.farm-music: node scripts/generate-farm-song.mjs && ffmpeg -v error -y -i public/audio/farm-song.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 44100 -b:a 192k public/audio/farm-song.mp3 && rm public/audio/farm-song.wav
